We need SMILES of the whole compound. We have fragments: 'CC(=O)O' (acetate?) and 'Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O' (p-hydroxybenzoic acid?). Combine? The molecular formula C9H8O4. Let's think: C9H8O4 corresponds to aspirin? Aspirin is C9H8O4, SMILES: CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O. Yes aspirin (acetylsalicylic acid). Fragments given: 'CC(=O)O' (acetyl group with OH) and 'Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O' (salicylic acid). Combined yields aspirin: CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O. So answer is that SMILES.
